name: One with the Land (Sielanic Ritual, Level One)

system.description:
This ritual lets a Sielanic caster attune herself to a specific plot of ground, no larger than 10 square miles, by combining her own blood with handfuls of earth from the claimed land and covering her body with the mixture before resting for the day. Thereafter she may enact the powers of the Path of the World's Blood within the designated area. A practitioner may only be attuned to one place at a time, though she may renew a lapsed attunement by repeating the ritual, or attune to a new location whenever she relocates.

System: The vampire combines her blood with a natural substance (animal blood, tree sap, or soil), then spends two blood points and rolls Willpower (difficulty 7). The number of successes determines the duration, intensity, or range of the desired effect.
system.source: Libellus Sanguinis II: Keepers of the Word, Book Two: Usurpers
